description: Breaks L3 (no Token-tagged cards): 19 legal ids plus core-065-1, the Spikey Pillow token SPEC §8 numbers 65.1. It necessarily breaks L5 as well, because a Token is never granted (R111 grants every non-Token card), so a deck holding one uses one copy of a card the profile owns zero of. The spec asserts the L3 sentence, which is the one that names Token cards.
